decisions.disposition: Enumerate exact source membership; order direct Station candidates by persisted stable ID for automatic choice and present explicit host selector. This is deterministic web adaptation, not nearest-host source parity. Preserve chosen host in saves.

Run source reparent sequence on detached candidate; preserve child disconnection even when descendant target becomes unresolved, reject self/cycles/malformed input without publishing any partial mutation. Bound traversal by validated platform count.

Retain both source paths and fifth-station missing reverse registration; store actual local ordered stations AND station membership separately. Do not enforce invented reciprocal equality or rebuild nearest-four on load. Interface shall expose this quirk to P7.

Keep raw selection/provenance and existing P2 diagnostic. No guessed corrected x or fallback art. P6-15 owns evidence-backed corrected selection/asset decision and all6 visual checks before gameplay visual acceptance; specification can close with named unresolved case.

Checked at original source width, preserve grouping and each float32 intermediate; reject out-of-range/nonfinite candidate atomically. Coordinates/IDs use existing checked contracts, money remains exact Int64 after valid source Int32 products. No new admission limits by planning.

Keep absent settings and station-location reuse per TRAIN-D012; use actual station ID/revision for resolution/conflicts, location for controller key, rail location separately. No Manual controller restoration.

Atomic committed effect envelope: fresh live epoch on process/replacement/reopen, publication sequence and ordinal; train/platform/bell IDs, current source location. Emit only after successful publication. Capture subscription baseline on join/reconnect, dedup within epoch, drop old epoch and pre-baseline events; no effect replay in snapshots/checkpoints or command receipts. Muted/locked/out-of-view drops never backlog; preview remains independent.

Use range8; per-voxel ExAV cut predicates; toward-zero yard index including one-overlength; .8/.9996 float decay, configured fare*distance*2 and P5 four-move cadence; platform180000*L. Do not reinterpret displayed units. DEV-D03 rail/slope remains P4 contract.

Preserve immediate creation, registration, listeners/timers and price booking. ConstructionSite is a reviewed negative dependency and EXAV-SCN020 remains calendar/P7 generic construction companion; do not add pending station construction or completion callbacks.

Use exact caller genres and zero bookings, platform pricing samples base ground only and underwater branch returns0; platform daily is relative24h whereas station daily aligned. Preserve zero-cost valid operations; never copy rail construction or memo costs.
Validate neighbors/material without writes or cast; stage replacement outlook only in commit; retain source forward-neighbor precedence, materials and no host service change.
Reuse task/inspector panels, station-ID selection, accessible sorted names and Move command. Preserve live log meaning and local label option; no native modal or secondary map window required.

Pin every core population class/table plus reachable special stadium interface; no shrink to five classes. P6 consumes controlled labeled supply/land inputs only until P7 real city producers; P8 full accounting histories. No experimental passenger cohorts.
Preserve source legal/no-effect cells and no standalone open-ended bridge creation, quote may be zero. Do not confuse PassagewayRail sprite helper with a registered constructible service platform.

dependencies.contract: Station footprint, traffic-owned yards, wide center voxels, before/car/after and station Gray cut silhouette are separate; no native HitTest dependency.
Exact station declarations, groups/providers, platform/passage pictures and bell resource closure; station-shaped railStationary decorations remain P4 accessories.
Actual owners install/remove ordinary or special listener, preserve provider instance identity and order. P7 owns buildings, stadium scheduling and full land evolution; P6 owns query/effect boundary.
Persist future action order and exact logs/genres; stage accounting, listener/landQ/traffic effects and callback state with one atomic successor; no CLR delegates/native timers.
